manifest.name: dsh-opencode-go-multi-quota
manifest.description: Multi-account OpenCode Go quota meter for DeepSeek Harness: auto-detects every OpenCode Go provider and follows the session provider.
manifest.author: jackgucarbon

bundle.text:
# 全局插件：OpenCode Go 多账号额度读数。
# Host 半注册 /plugin/opencode-go-multi-quota，按 PROVIDERS 里登记的账号读取凭据；
# Client 半在 conversation.composer.dock 里渲染常驻读数，并跟随当前会话的 provider。
- insert:
    - id: opencode-go-multi-quota
      name: 'dsh-opencode-go-multi-quota'

readme.text:
A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that shows **OpenCode Go** quota for **every configured account** under the composer, and follows the provider selected in the current session.

[中文说明](README.zh.md) · [DSH plugins](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方显示**所有已配置 OpenCode Go 账号**的剩余额度（5 小时 / 每周 / 每月），并跟随当前会话的 provider 自动切换。

- 从 `llm-pi-ai.providers` 自动识别账号，不在插件里写死数量。
- 按账号数自适应：1 个账号用 320px 紧凑卡，2 个账号用 360px 双列矩阵，3 个以上用「当前账号 + 其他账号」可展开列表，不横向滚动。
- 当前账号列（或当前账号卡）高亮，`限流` 标红，每格带剩余、已用和 `↻` 重置时间。
- 凭据只在 Host 进程解析，页面只拿到百分比；不会下发 key。
- 完整中文说明见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)。

- **Multi-account, auto-detected.** Reads `llm-pi-ai.providers` and picks every provider that looks like OpenCode Go. No account count in the plugin code.
- **Follows the session provider.** Uses the session-scoped `modelDirectories` store; switching models swaps the pill immediately.
- **Adaptive layout.** One account uses a 320px compact card; two accounts use a 360px two-column matrix; three or more use a current-account card plus expandable rows for the others, with no horizontal scrolling. The active account is highlighted; `rate-limited` cells are marked in red.
- **All the facts, compactly.** Each cell shows remaining %, used %, and reset time (`↻`). Same-day resets show only `HH:mm`; other days show `MM/DD HH:mm`.
- **Per-account cache.** The host caches each provider separately for 60 seconds, and one failing account does not break the others.
- **No keys in the browser.** The host resolves credential refs and calls the usage API; the client only receives percentages.

If the loader config cannot be read, the host falls back to the two conventional refs `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` and `OPENCODE_API_KEY`. A config with no matching provider shows “No OpenCode accounts found” instead of an endless spinner.

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5` (or a compatible `0.2.x`; see `engines.dsh`).
- At least one OpenCode Go provider in `llm-pi-ai.providers` with an `apiKeyEnv` that resolves through DSH credentials or the environment.
- The standard web client with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`; the plugin uses it to follow the session provider.

> This package is distributed from GitHub only; no npm release is published. Use the GitHub spec below.

Recommended: open **Plugins → Install** in the DSH web UI and install from the GitHub spec:

```text
github:jackgucarbon/dsh-opencode-go-multi-quota
```

The Plugin Manager adds the bundle to the profile and reloads it.

CLI installs only add the package dependency; add the bundle to `dsh.profile.bundles` yourself:

The host registers a same-origin read-only route:

| Request | Response |
|---|---|
| `GET /plugin/opencode-go-multi-quota` | Default provider (first discovered, or `opencode-go`) |
| `GET /plugin/opencode-go-multi-quota?provider=opencode` | One named provider |
| `GET /plugin/opencode-go-multi-quota?provider=all` | Every discovered account, plus a `detected` flag |
| `...&refresh=1` | Bypass the 60-second cache |
The upstream endpoint is `GET https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage` with a Bearer token. It is read-only and does not consume plan quota.

- Credential values stay in the host process. They are never logged, returned by the route, or sent to the page.
- The only network request is the usage call to `opencode.ai`; the plugin has no telemetry.
- The quota route is same-origin and read-only, but it is **not authenticated** and `refresh=1` bypasses the cache. Do not expose the DSH web server to untrusted networks without adding a proxy or auth layer in front of it.
- The auto-discovery rule is intentionally broad. If you have a non-Go OpenCode provider with an `OPENCODE` ref, it may appear and fail; narrow the rule or remove that provider from `llm-pi-ai.providers`.

```sh
npm test
```

The tests use fake API keys and a mocked `fetch`; no real credentials are needed. `test/client.test.mjs` runs the client module against a tiny hook runtime and a fake model directory, so it checks provider switching and the popover without a browser.

Built and tested against DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5`. The plugin uses the client `modelDirectories` service and the host `loader`, `credentials`, and `webServer` services; breaking changes to those services will need a plugin update.
MIT. Not affiliated with OpenCode or DeepSeek; “OpenCode” and “DeepSeek” are used descriptively.
